thread:
rachel: Heads-up: nightly telemetry diff showed embedding latencies drop and token-count mismatches after sdk-agent:3.0.0 rolled to staging. Looks correlated to batching reorder.

tom: Which models/fleets? Any prod impact yet?

rachel: Affects embedder-v5 on staging and dedicated-test. No prod alerts, but QA recall tests fail on dedicated-test. Latency median down (good) but token-count offsets cause chunked streams to misalign.

ash: Quick mitigation proposal: pin SDK to 2.9.8 for model-tag=embedder-v5 in staging & dedicated-test for 4h while we back out the reorder. Keep scope tight.

deploy-bot: Suggested command: `/deploy pin sdk:2.9.8 --scope=model-tag:embedder-v5 --filter=fleet:staging,fleet:dedicated-test --expires=4h --reason="token-count and latency diff after sdk-agent:3.0.0"`

telemetry-bot: Telemetry snapshot attached in-thread. Will post +10m and +1h diffs once pin applied.

rachel: I agree with scoped pin. Releases: please add a short note to the next changelog entry and mark customer-facing impact as low.

release-coordinator: Will do. Also request runtime & SDK teams to include a test-case in the regression suite for token-count alignment.

ash: Applying pin now: `/deploy pin sdk:2.9.8 --scope=model-tag:embedder-v5 --filter=fleet:staging,fleet:dedicated-test --expires=4h --reason="token-count and latency diff after sdk-agent:3.0.0"`

deploy-bot: Pin created ✅

- target: sdk:2.9.8
